params.baseline_threshold_method: 90% of the average daily Verified Net Revenue per Trading Day over the 90 days before the Funding Date, fixed at signing at EUR 703.26

investment_amount.source_quote: The Investor shall pay the Merchant EUR 20,000 (the "Investment Amount").

funding_date.source_quote: The Investment Amount is funded on 2026-11-06 (the "Funding Date").

day_basis.source_quote: On each Trading Day starting on the Funding Date, the Merchant shall contribute to the Investor 5% of Verified Net Revenue per Trading Day up to the Baseline Threshold of EUR 703.26, and 3% on the portion of Verified Net Revenue above the Baseline Threshold (together, the "Daily Contribution").

timezone.source_quote: Trading Days and daily cut-off times are determined in the Europe/Berlin time zone.

revenue_base.source_quote: "Total Receipts" means all amounts received by the Merchant from customers for completed sales through any payment channel, including PayPal, card, cash and bank transfer.

tiers.source_quote: On each Trading Day starting on the Funding Date, the Merchant shall contribute to the Investor 5% of Verified Net Revenue per Trading Day up to the Baseline Threshold of EUR 703.26, and 3% on the portion of Verified Net Revenue above the Baseline Threshold (together, the "Daily Contribution").

baseline_threshold_amount.source_quote: "Baseline Threshold" means 90% of the average daily Verified Net Revenue per Trading Day over the 90 days before the Funding Date, fixed at signing at EUR 703.26.

baseline_threshold_method.source_quote: "Baseline Threshold" means 90% of the average daily Verified Net Revenue per Trading Day over the 90 days before the Funding Date, fixed at signing at EUR 703.26.

cap_multiple.source_quote: The Merchant's total Daily Contributions are capped at 1.15 times the Investment Amount, being EUR 23,000 (the "Repayment Cap").

cap_amount.source_quote: The Merchant's total Daily Contributions are capped at 1.15 times the Investment Amount, being EUR 23,000 (the "Repayment Cap").

max_term_months.source_quote: The maximum term of this Agreement is 24 months from the Funding Date.

settlement_frequency.source_quote: The Daily Contribution is settled daily via PayPal Payouts to the Escrow Account.

collection_method.source_quote: Contributions are collected daily from the Merchant's PayPal balance; if the balance is insufficient, the shortfall is collected by SEPA direct debit from the Merchant's nominated bank account.

fallback_collection.source_quote: Contributions are collected daily from the Merchant's PayPal balance; if the balance is insufficient, the shortfall is collected by SEPA direct debit from the Merchant's nominated bank account.

payout_fee_borne_by.source_quote: PayPal payout fees are borne by the Merchant in addition to the Daily Contribution; they are charged to the Merchant separately and are not deducted from the amount transferred.

servicing_fee_rate.source_quote: The Servicer is entitled to a servicing fee of 5% of each Daily Contribution (the "Servicing Fee").

health_trigger_drop_pct.source_quote: If the average Verified Net Revenue over the last 7 Trading Days falls more than 20% below the average over the last 30 Trading Days, the revenue share rate of 5% may be reduced to 3% for up to 30 days, subject to the approval of the Investor.

health_window_short_days.source_quote: If the average Verified Net Revenue over the last 7 Trading Days falls more than 20% below the average over the last 30 Trading Days, the revenue share rate of 5% may be reduced to 3% for up to 30 days, subject to the approval of the Investor.

health_window_long_days.source_quote: If the average Verified Net Revenue over the last 7 Trading Days falls more than 20% below the average over the last 30 Trading Days, the revenue share rate of 5% may be reduced to 3% for up to 30 days, subject to the approval of the Investor.

reduced_rate.source_quote: If the average Verified Net Revenue over the last 7 Trading Days falls more than 20% below the average over the last 30 Trading Days, the revenue share rate of 5% may be reduced to 3% for up to 30 days, subject to the approval of the Investor.

reduced_rate_max_days.source_quote: If the average Verified Net Revenue over the last 7 Trading Days falls more than 20% below the average over the last 30 Trading Days, the revenue share rate of 5% may be reduced to 3% for up to 30 days, subject to the approval of the Investor.

requires_investor_approval.source_quote: No reduction applies without the Investor's approval.

card_gap_breach_days.source_quote: Unexplained card-revenue gaps of 3 or more Trading Days constitute a reporting breach by the Merchant.

channel_share_drop_trigger_pp.source_quote: If the PayPal share of Total Receipts falls more than 15 percentage points below its 90-day pre-funding baseline, the Servicer may request a written explanation and a review; this alone is not an event of default.

monthly_report_days.source_quote: The Merchant shall deliver to the Investor in electronic form: (a) within 10 days after each month-end, a statement of Total Receipts for that month by payment channel, including cash and other receipts outside PayPal; (b) within 14 days after filing, a copy of each periodic VAT return (Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung); and (c) within 6 months after each financial year-end, its annual financial statements and the related income tax filing or assessment.
